name: Songs
overview: Scripture reveals that songs are a vital expression of worship and trust in the Lord, reflecting joy and praise in His presence. Believers are encouraged to sing new songs of praise to God, celebrating His strength, protection, and the fullness of life found at His right hand. Singing is an act of heartfelt worship, inviting reverence and adoration toward the Creator, as seen in calls to praise God in His sanctuary and with all power.
